title: 4521-ESP-ANC-68-61-CS51
summary: This document outlines material and installation standards for various water service systems, including cooling, hot, process, and chemical feed piping. It specifies pipe sizes, materials, fittings, flanges, bolting, gaskets, and valves with special considerations for cut groove piping and installation techniques.
